lines.zh: 我沿着珊瑚的缝游，尽量不露头。
lines.en: I swim along the coral seams, keeping my head low.

lines.zh: 尾一摆，我就窜出去半米。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I shoot half a meter.

lines.zh: 温水海洋里，我游得最自在。
lines.en: In warm ocean water I swim most easily.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁盘转，那里能藏身。
lines.en: I circle the reef flat, where I can hide.

lines.zh: 上面有大鱼的影子，我往下压。
lines.en: A big fish shadows overhead, so I drop lower.

lines.zh: 我游成一折一折的，像在躲什么。
lines.en: I swim in sharp turns, as if dodging something.

lines.zh: 浅海的光落在背上，斑纹更明显。
lines.en: Shallow light falls on my back and my bands show.

lines.zh: 水流往岸推，我偏要逆着走。
lines.en: The current pushes shoreward and I swim against it.

lines.zh: 我穿过一群小鱼，它们先散了。
lines.en: I pass a shoal of small fish and they scatter first.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝擦过我的侧腹，有点疼。
lines.en: Coral branches graze my flank and it stings.

lines.zh: 转身的时候，我把尾巴甩得很响。
lines.en: When I turn, my tail cracks loudly through the water.

lines.zh: 深水珊瑚礁的坡很陡，我缓缓下潜。
lines.en: The deep reef slope is steep and I descend carefully.

lines.zh: 一条海鳗从洞里看我，我加速了。
lines.en: A moray watches from its hole and I speed up.

lines.zh: 每次摆尾，我都先看一眼身后。
lines.en: Every tailbeat, I glance behind me first.

lines.zh: 我顺着暗流滑，省点力气。
lines.en: I ride the undertow to save strength.

lines.zh: 礁石缝隙里，我侧身挤过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and squeeze through the reef crack.

lines.zh: 上面亮，我不去，底下凉。
lines.en: It's bright above; I stay down where it's cool.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的幅度很小，怕被看见。
lines.en: I flick my tail barely at all, afraid of being seen.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚枝下，鳍轻轻摆。
lines.en: I hover under a coral branch, fins moving lightly.

lines.zh: 这片礁石我熟，闭着眼也能待。
lines.en: I know this reef; I could rest here blind.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃，我看了很久。
lines.en: Light wavers on the surface and I watch it long.

lines.zh: 张嘴等小虾自己游进来。
lines.en: Mouth open, waiting for shrimp to swim in.

lines.zh: 有东西在礁缝里动，我不去管。
lines.en: Something stirs in the reef crack; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让暖水照在腹上。
lines.en: I turn on my side to let warm water reach my belly.

lines.zh: 我盯着水里飘的沙粒发呆。
lines.en: I stare at drifting sand grains and think nothing.

lines.zh: 这片温水海洋，今天很平。
lines.en: This warm ocean is calm today.

lines.zh: 温水里的海鲈，从不着急。
lines.en: A warm-water bass, never in a hurry.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子在沙上慢慢移。
lines.en: The coral's shadow moves slowly over the sand.

lines.zh: 我待在一个刚好能容身的位置。
lines.en: I hold a spot just big enough for me.

lines.zh: 有只小虾爬过我嘴边，我没张嘴。
lines.en: A shrimp crawls past my mouth and I do not open it.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，礁顶露出来一块。
lines.en: The tide drops and a patch of reef shows.

lines.zh: 什么都不追的时候，我最放松。
lines.en: When I chase nothing, I relax the most.

lines.zh: 你站在礁石上，影子投进水里。
lines.en: You stand on the reef and your shadow enters the water.

lines.zh: 你手里那根线，我见过。
lines.en: That line in your hand, I have seen it before.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游了一圈，没敢靠近。
lines.en: I circle you once and dare not come closer.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了一块珊瑚。
lines.en: Your boot crushed a piece of coral.

lines.zh: 你低头看我，我就往下沉一点。
lines.en: You look down at me, so I sink a little.

lines.zh: 我认得捕鱼的人，你身上有那味道。
lines.en: I know fishers; you carry that smell.

lines.zh: 你的影子比鲨鱼的小，可我还是怕。
lines.en: Your shadow is smaller than a shark's, and I still fear it.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚后面探头，只看了一眼。
lines.en: I peek from behind the coral for one look.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也悬着不动。
lines.en: You stay still, and I hang still too.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，我会跑。
lines.en: Do not put your hand in the water; I will bolt.

lines.zh: 疼，我的侧腹被划开一道。
lines.en: It hurts; a line opens along my flank.

lines.zh: 我甩尾想跑，却撞上珊瑚。
lines.en: I flick my tail to flee and hit the coral.

lines.zh: 鳞掉了一片，水里飘着银光。
lines.en: A scale comes off and silver drifts in the water.

lines.zh: 这一下让我沉到了礁底。
lines.en: That blow drops me to the reef floor.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴喘，鳃动得很快。
lines.en: I gape for breath and my gills work fast.

lines.zh: 血味散开了，会引来别的东西。
lines.en: The blood spreads and will bring other things.

lines.zh: 我躲进珊瑚，抖得停不下来。
lines.en: I hide in the coral and cannot stop shaking.

lines.zh: 六点生命，掉得比我想的快。
lines.en: Six points of life are going faster than I thought.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，好一会才正过来。
lines.en: I roll over and take a while to right myself.

lines.zh: 疼得我忘了该往哪边游。
lines.en: It hurts so much I forget which way to swim.

lines.zh: 那股腥味散开，我的鳍自己动了。
lines.en: That fishy smell spreads and my fins move on their own.

lines.zh: 是饵吧，我闻过这种东西。
lines.en: That is bait; I have smelled this before.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈，还是忍不住靠近。
lines.en: I circle twice, and still I drift closer.

lines.zh: 虾的味道从钩边飘出来。
lines.en: The smell of shrimp drifts from beside the hook.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，来回好几次。
lines.en: I open my mouth and shut it, several times.

lines.zh: 这块肉太香，香得不对劲。
lines.en: This flesh smells too good, good in a wrong way.

lines.zh: 我贴到很近，才看见那根线。
lines.en: Only up close do I see the line.

lines.zh: 你晃一下，我就跟着偏一下。
lines.en: Each time you twitch it, I tilt toward it.

lines.zh: 我的同类也来了，我得快点。
lines.en: My kind are coming too, so I must be quick.

lines.zh: 香是香，可我不打算为它送命。
lines.en: Tempting as it is, I will not die for it.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我整条鱼都弹开了。
lines.en: One touch and my whole body springs away.

lines.zh: 撞在礁石上，我的侧腹擦破了。
lines.en: I hit the reef and scrape my flank open.

lines.zh: 你的手从我背上滑过去，我逃了。
lines.en: Your hand slides over my back and I flee.

lines.zh: 水被搅乱，我一时找不到方向。
lines.en: The water churns and I lose my bearings.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻过来，露出白肚。
lines.en: The knock rolls me over, showing my pale belly.

lines.zh: 别用网兜撞我，鳞会掉。
lines.en: Do not bang that net into me; scales come off.

lines.zh: 我甩尾打回去，只是碰了一下。
lines.en: I slap back with my tail and only graze you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我退进了珊瑚缝。
lines.en: That shove sends me back into a coral gap.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁盘滑开，躲得还算快。
lines.en: I slide along the reef flat and dodge quickly enough.

lines.zh: 撞完我绕了半圈，才敢再出来。
lines.en: After the bump I circle half a turn before coming out.

lines.zh: 另一条海鲈游近，尾鳍扫过我。
lines.en: Another sea bass nears and its tail fin brushes me.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，节奏慢慢合上了。
lines.en: We swim side by side and our rhythm settles together.

lines.zh: 它的斑纹比我的深一些。
lines.en: Its bands are a little darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块珊瑚打转。
lines.en: We circle the same coral head together.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，它也摆尾，像在答话。
lines.en: I flick my tail, it flicks back, as if answering.

lines.zh: 温水把我们推到一处浅湾。
lines.en: The warm current pushes us into the same shallow bay.

lines.zh: 它先转向，我跟了上去。
lines.en: It turns first, and I follow after.

lines.zh: 两条鱼游成一条线，看着像一条。
lines.en: Two fish swim in one line and look like one.

lines.zh: 这片礁够大，够我们分着住。
lines.en: This reef is big enough for us to share.

lines.zh: 等卵沉到珊瑚下，我就在旁边守着。
lines.en: When the eggs settle under the coral, I stay nearby.

lines.zh: 有块碎珊瑚沉下来，我去看看。
lines.en: A piece of coral sinks, so I go look.

lines.zh: 我叼了一下，又吐了出来。
lines.en: I mouth it once, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 那不是吃的，可我还是捡了。
lines.en: It is not food, but I pick it up anyway.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推着它走了一段。
lines.en: I push it with my mouth for a short way.

lines.zh: 一粒亮的东西落进礁缝。
lines.en: Something bright falls into the reef crack.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，很快就丢了。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth and soon lose it.

lines.zh: 太重，我试了两次都抬不动。
lines.en: Too heavy; I try twice and cannot lift it.

lines.zh: 这块东西闻起来像别的鱼。
lines.en: This thing smells like some other fish.

lines.zh: 我捡完就游开，不带走。
lines.en: I pick it up, then swim off without it.

lines.zh: 水里掉下的东西，总要先咬一口。
lines.en: Whatever falls in the water, I bite first.

lines.zh: 上面那片影子，比礁石还大。
lines.en: That shadow above is bigger than the reef.

lines.zh: 我停住鳍，只剩尾巴在动。
lines.en: I stop my fins and only my tail moves.

lines.zh: 是鲨鱼，我认得那个轮廓。
lines.en: It is a shark; I know that outline.

lines.zh: 有东西在礁缝里闪了一下。
lines.en: Something flashes inside the reef crack.

lines.zh: 礁缝里太窄，我先看着。
lines.en: The reef gap is too narrow; I watch for now.

lines.zh: 它朝这边来了，我往珊瑚里钻。
lines.en: It comes this way, so I dive into the coral.

lines.zh: 这条比我小，也许能试一下。
lines.en: This one is smaller; perhaps I can try.

lines.zh: 我一动，它也动了，那就不是石头。
lines.en: It moves when I move, so it is not stone.

lines.zh: 我记住它游的方向了。
lines.en: I have its swimming direction marked.

lines.zh: 现在跑还来得及，我先走。
lines.en: There is still time to run, so I go.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着它，不敢松。
lines.en: I keep after it and dare not lose it.

lines.zh: 它转弯，我也转弯，隔着一段水。
lines.en: It turns, I turn, with water between us.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只装得下那一块。
lines.en: My eyes hold nothing but that one shape.

lines.zh: 它慢下来了，我也慢下来。
lines.en: It slows, and I slow with it.

lines.zh: 珊瑚挡住了，我绕过去再看。
lines.en: Coral blocks it; I go around and look again.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的尾，不看别处。
lines.en: I watch its tail and nothing else.

lines.zh: 距离刚好，再近就危险。
lines.en: The distance is right; closer would be dangerous.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，我还压着身体。
lines.en: It has not seen me, and I stay low.

lines.zh: 这一口气我憋得有点久。
lines.en: I have held this breath a little too long.

lines.zh: 它游走了，我的身体才松。
lines.en: It swims off, and only then does my body loosen.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，只扯下一片鳞。
lines.en: I bite once and only tear off a scale.

lines.zh: 我的牙不大，咬不深。
lines.en: My teeth are small and do not bite deep.

lines.zh: 撞它一下，我自己先退开。
lines.en: I ram it once, and I back off first.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了脱身，不是要赢。
lines.en: This strike is to escape, not to win.

lines.zh: 我甩尾抽过去，声音比力气大。
lines.en: I whip my tail across; the sound is louder than the force.

lines.zh: 它疼了一下，我也被弹开。
lines.en: It flinches, and I am knocked away too.

lines.zh: 我咬住又松开，怕牙卡住。
lines.en: I bite and release, afraid my teeth will catch.

lines.zh: 六点生命，只够我打这一下。
lines.en: Six points of life only buy me this one hit.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，水花先到了。
lines.en: I rush in, and the splash arrives first.

lines.zh: 打不动，我就转身游开。
lines.en: If it will not yield, I turn and swim off.

lines.zh: 我在深水珊瑚礁的缝里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in a crack of the deep coral reef.

lines.zh: 一起出来的还有两条同类。
lines.en: Two of my kind emerge with me.

lines.zh: 浅海的光透过水，照在我背上。
lines.en: Shallow light comes through the water onto my back.

lines.zh: 我一出生就先找珊瑚躲。
lines.en: Born, I look for coral to hide in first.

lines.zh: 温水的味道，我一下就认得了。
lines.en: I know the taste of warm water at once.

lines.zh: 礁盘上很热闹，也处处是嘴。
lines.en: The reef flat is busy, and full of mouths.

lines.zh: 我摆了两下尾，才稳住身体。
lines.en: Two beats of my tail steady me.

lines.zh: 上面有影子游过，我立刻沉下去。
lines.en: A shadow passes above and I drop at once.

lines.zh: 从卵到鱼，我只用了一小会。
lines.en: From egg to fish took me only a moment.

lines.zh: 这条浅海，我打算先待着。
lines.en: I plan to stay in these shallows for now.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我这边只剩热。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; down here it is only heat.

lines.zh: 我被水柱甩出去，摔在礁上。
lines.en: The current flung me out and I struck the reef.

lines.zh: 我离了水，鳃一张一合地空动。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills open and close on nothing.

lines.zh: 炸响之后，礁石碎了一片。
lines.en: After the blast, a stretch of reef is shattered.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进来，从我身上穿过去。
lines.en: Something drove in and passed through my body.

lines.zh: 那力量一裹，我的鳞全竖起来。
lines.en: That force wraps me and every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 礁缝里没有小虾，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: No shrimp in the reef cracks and I grow desperate.

lines.zh: 白光打进浅海，我一下僵住。
lines.en: White light strikes the shallows and I freeze.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的鳃吸不到东西。
lines.en: No water here; my gills draw nothing.
